title: North San Jose：Townhouse、Condo 与持有成本
title_en: North San Jose: townhomes, condos and holding costs
intro: 95131 位于 North San Jose 的重要住宅区域，在 US-101 以北，大部分夹在 I-880 和 I-680 之间，东侧接 Berryessa，向北靠近 Milpitas。这里拥有不同年代的独栋、Townhouse 和 Condo，较新的联排和公寓多带 HOA；日常采购和就医常在片区内或 Milpitas 一带解决，三条高速都在附近，BART 的 Berryessa/North San José 站也不远。适合需要比较就业中心通勤与物业维护成本的买家研究。
intro_en: 95131 is a key residential part of North San Jose, north of US-101 and mostly between I-880 and I-680, with Berryessa to the east and Milpitas to the north. It has single-family homes, townhomes and condos from different eras, and the newer townhomes and condos usually come with an HOA. Errands and medical visits tend to stay in the area or head to Milpitas, three freeways are close by, and the Berryessa/North San José BART station is not far. It suits buyers comparing the commute to nearby job centers against the cost of keeping a property up.
buyer: 购买 Townhouse 或 Condo 时，不能只比较房价，还要检查 HOA 月费、储备金、特别征费、保险责任、租赁限制和社区维护情况。
buyer_en: With a townhome or condo, price is only part of the comparison. Review HOA dues, reserves, special assessments, insurance responsibilities, rental limits and how well the community is kept up.
seller: 应按产权类型、建筑面积、车位、HOA 和同社区成交进行定价。把独栋和 Condo 放在同一组可比房里，很容易得出误导性结论。
seller_en: Price by ownership type, size, parking, HOA and sales in the same community. Putting single-family homes and condos in one comparison set can easily mislead.
